name: starting architecture
last_analysis: No scores are shown, so these choices rest on reasoning, not results. All 9 trials trained without errors, and the compute ratio r for every network stayed near 1, so there is room for small changes. Two ideas were tested separately but never together. One is the cell head with the stem skip (r3c1), which keeps exact per-column detail for each footprint cell. The other is 2 PPO epochs, which gives about 1.8x more fresh designs (r2c1, r3c2). Since there is no feedback and this is the last round, I am betting on combinations that each look reasonable, not on single-change tests. Combination 1: stem-skip cell head with 2 epochs. Combination 2: the same network with 1 epoch, which pushes sample count further (about 420k steps). Combination 3: add a dilated residual convolution, so every cell sees most of the 8x8 grid. That should help with placement order around overhangs and with DONE timing, at a modest cost.
